facts.text: Moon woke up the next day feeling comfortable and safe in Hemlock’s arms.
Moon yawned softly after waking up.

Moon asked Tom what was up.
Moon wondered how her brother Charlie would think about her now.
Moon’s brother Charlie called Moon the quiet sibling.
Moon had a good relationship with her brother Charlie.
Moon checked the clock and noticed the time.
Moon scheduled an appointment with Prof. Maximus.
Moon’s appointment with Prof. Maximus was in fifteen.
Moon wanted to run a few tests to see if there were any lingering effects from the virus.
